'''Zaarin's fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] warships that acted as rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|government]] military. Originally, it was a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], but joined Zaarin after his betrayal and fought in [[Zaarin insurrection|his insurrection]]. They engaged loyalist Imperial forces, most notably those of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. His fleet had a technological advantage, as Zaarin led research into new [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters. Despite their advantage, the fleet was ultimately defeated.

They had a well sized fleet, ranging from [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyers]] to [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]]. The main fighters included [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] and [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s. The fleet used a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as a ground force. Nearly every unit in the fleet since the [[Battle of Ottega]] was given a "Z-" in front of the name to designate it was a member (such as [[Z-Beta Squadron]]).
